name: reno-budget-bsj1
description: BSJ-1 verification: open the whole-renovation budget allocator on the default furnished 4-room flat with a budget target set, and screenshot the trade-line breakdown.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: wait-panel-mount
steps.failMessage: Renovation budget aux panel did not mount

steps.name: verify-panel-content
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Renovation budget')) throw new Error('panel is not the renovation budget: ' + t.slice(0,120)); if (/NaN/.test(t)) throw new Error('NaN in panel: ' + t.slice(0,200)); return t.slice(0,400); })()
